data: DNR 7.0.3 original width-12 car trees and JavaScript redline tables
limitations: All effects present in the provided CONSPIT V1.6 framework retained; not a claim to include every effect introduced by newer official DNR device profiles.
TDM option affects the updated car-specific RPM branches; existing wheel/F1 effect colors remain the original framework colors.
F1 2026 is enabled using existing field layouts; telemetry compatibility requires game testing.
Hardware-specific raw telemetry availability still depends on SimHub and the game.
